entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Christmas is canceled!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They can't be sold out everywhere![n]It's not Christmas if we can't get[n]roasted chicken!
We need cake, right?
We have pork in the fridge...
I'm fine if I've got you.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ugh, I guess. Let's keep it together.[n]We can still get some cake!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Pork!? Screw pork!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I got principles, y'know. And one of[n]those is chicken at Christmas! We[n]might as well skip to dessert!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Urgh, I don't know how to respond[n]to that...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But I refuse to quit! Our new quest:[n]securing a cake!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Onward!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ugh, looks like they're out too...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Um, 'scuse me? Do you have any[n]Christmas cake left?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Actually, we do!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, game... over?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: One of our orders was canceled last-[n]minute. This is the only cake we have!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What? Really!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then yeah! We want it!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Of course! Just wait one moment[n]while I go prepare your order!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whooaa... Is this for real?
'Tis the season for miracles.
'Tis a Christmas miracle.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 'Tis!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And we even got it from a super fancy cake[n]shop! Christmas is hereby uncanceled.
